authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: "If the picture string contains only one sub-picture, the prefix for the negative sub-picture is set by concatenating the minus-sign character and the prefix for the positive sub-picture (if any), in that order". XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.5: "If there is no decimal-separator character in the sub-picture, or if there are no digits to the right of the decimal-separator character in the string, then the decimal-separator character is removed from the string".
